# SCI-FRUIT ordinary-MAP method-scope r0.2 manifest

Proposal identity: `SCI-FRUIT-ORDINARY-MAP-METHOD-SCOPE-R0.2`.
Date: 2026-09-08. Scientific owner: Grant Wilson.
Base: `de6a3a53e2925f7315b081474d48caa1d825514a`.
Status: successor proposal, exact owner scope/reference disposition pending.
Numerical FRUIT methods remain unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval.

Supersedes only the unapproved JINC-first recommendation in the historical-control
method-scope r0.1 packet. That complete packet and archive are unchanged; archive
SHA-256 `eaa19432deee25dd5d7cff6a6934da6a7b980c6daef6121dec3e3f2b7b057228`.
Generic FRUIT v0.1/r0.4 and upstream frozen science remain unchanged.
The new proposal follows the supplied sidebar but selects no feedback projection,
coefficient, numerical support value, method instance or experiment. D001–D005
remain open. Program-order, conditional composition and numerical authority
remain separate; no new authorship exception or dispatch is granted.

This is a manager/owner archive, not an independent author packet. Only the
restricted proposed reference control may define a future approved author input
set. The sidebar and all historical implementation/evidence are manager-only.
Copied source links retain original context without transitive source admission.
The two opaque untracked review archives and reduction products are not included.

This manifest lists every payload. It excludes itself, its sidecar, the tar.gz
and the external archive sidecar. The tar.gz contains all payloads plus this
manifest and its sidecar under one named root. The three repository navigation
updates are committed with this packet, outside the scientific payload set.
